description: Offline password strength audit (POST only, so the password never appears in a URL or access log; never echoed or stored): zxcvbn-style score 0-4, estimated guesses and entropy, crack-time estimates, weak patterns (common/breached passwords incl. l33t and reversed, keyboard walks, sequences, repeats, dates, personal info) and NIST SP 800-63B checks. Body: { "password": "...", "user_inputs"?: ["alice", "alice@example.com"] }. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/password-strength

password.description: Password to evaluate, 1-256 chars (JSON body only; never returned)

user_inputs.description: Optional personal context (username, email, name) that should not appear in the password
